summary: Iteration 11: Full testing of Ethereal achievement skin implementation. All 8 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI correctly displays Ethereal with MYTHIC badge, trophy icon, +10% bonus, achievement label, and unlock requirements.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/skins/catalog - Returns Ethereal in achievement_skins with correct properties (name, bonus_percent=10, rarity=mythic, achievement=true, price_sol=0)
Backend: GET /api/skins/catalog - Confirms 10 purchasable skins exist for achievement requirement
Backend: GET /api/skins/achievement-status/{wallet} - Returns 0/10 progress for new wallet
Backend: GET /api/skins/achievement-status/{wallet} - Returns all required fields (unlocked, progress, required, missing_skins, bonus_percent, rarity)
Backend: GET /api/skins/owned/{wallet} - Returns empty array for new wallet
Backend: POST /api/skins/gift - Correctly rejects gifting Ethereal with 'Cannot gift achievement skins' error
Backend: GET /api/skins/catalog - Ethereal correctly merged into all_skins response
Backend: missing_skins contains valid purchasable skin IDs
Frontend: Ethereal skin card displayed with data-testid='skin-ethereal'
Frontend: MYTHIC rarity badge shown on Ethereal card (pink styling)
Frontend: Trophy icon visible on Ethereal card
Frontend: 'Achievement Skin' label appears on hover overlay
Frontend: 'Own all 10 purchasable skins' unlock requirement text shown
Frontend: Correct Ethereal image URL loaded
Frontend: 12 total skin cards displayed (1 default + 1 ethereal + 10 purchasable)
Frontend: 'Loading...' progress text shown when no wallet connected (expected behavior)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: check_and_unlock_ethereal() correctly auto-unlocks when user owns all 10 purchasable skins
Backend: Gift API properly prevents Ethereal from being gifted (line 2490-2491)
Backend: PURCHASABLE_SKIN_IDS list correctly excludes achievement skins
Frontend: SKINS config includes ethereal with achievement=true flag
Frontend: RARITY_COLORS includes mythic styling (pink theme)
Frontend: SkinStore.js fetchAchievementStatus() correctly fetches progress from API
Frontend: Achievement skins have special UI treatment (trophy icon, grayscale when locked, pink border)
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - tests use unique TEST_ prefixed wallet addresses
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 verified Ethereal achievement skin: Backend APIs tested include /api/skins/catalog (returns ethereal in achievement_skins), /api/skins/achievement-status/{wallet} (returns progress 0/10, required 10, missing_skins list, unlocked bool), /api/skins/owned/{wallet} (auto-unlock check), POST /api/skins/gift (rejects ethereal with 400 'Cannot gift achievement skins'). Frontend correctly displays ethereal with MYTHIC pink badge, trophy icon, +10% bonus, achievement overlay with progress bar and unlock requirements. When wallet not connected, shows 'Loading...' for progress.
